selection_rationale.scope_boundary: Opt-in research-only physical storage. No checked-in universe data, SEC source bundle, materialization envelope, runtime/observation reader, CandidatePool, signal, outcome, policy, scheduler, broker, order, allocation, evidence tier, parity status, or trading permission changed.

implementation.shared_transaction_guard: The legacy writer now separates pre-I/O request/M1 preparation from locked-history classification, and both legacy and segmented paths reuse those exact helpers. Source/evidence, calendar/clock, event/manifest/batch, PIT, default-off, duplicate, conflict, and legacy validation-before-timeout-before-I/O ordering remain enforced.
implementation.explicit_bootstrap: Bootstrap accepts only the first events plus manifest and complete M1 evidence/calendar inputs; it cannot publish an arbitrary structurally valid legacy view. With no HEAD it accepts only a virgin root or the one exact planned checkpoint with zero segments from a failed first publication. Existing segment history without HEAD fails closed instead of rolling back.
implementation.segmented_append: Each successful append publishes exactly one immutable segment containing one unchanged v1 transaction, including zero-event manifests, then publishes a constant-size HEAD that binds the new tail. Exact retries return duplicate and never add another physical event or segment.
implementation.publication_protocol: Checkpoint and segment records use exact canonical LF bytes, fsynced same-directory temporary files, and create-only hard links; existing content-addressed paths are reused only for exact bytes and are never overwritten. All API writers use one OS advisory lock, immutable records publish before HEAD, predecessor HEAD bytes are rechecked immediately before binary temp+fsync+atomic replace, and the committed view is strictly reloaded.
implementation.crash_and_orphan_semantics: A failure before HEAD leaves the old committed view unchanged and any complete new object unreachable/audit-only; exact retry may reuse only its deterministic hash/bytes. If HEAD replacement committed but the caller did not receive success, retry classifies the transaction as duplicate. No rollback or orphan auto-selection exists.
implementation.honest_ceiling: The guarantee covers cooperating API writers and process-level torn-write/crash windows. It does not claim a cross-platform conditional replace against writers that bypass the advisory lock, parent-directory fsync/power-loss durability, repository-external rollback detection, compact checkpoint rotation, runtime reader wiring, canonical evidence, or production authority.
